turns.text: 34 lbs, not including your bipod, which adds some heft.
turns.zh: 34磅，还不算你的两脚架，那玩意儿还得再加点分量。

turns.text: For most applications, I would tend to agree.
turns.zh: 对大多数用途来说，我基本同意。
尤金·斯通纳设计的半自动。

turns.text: Not quite the range or the punch of the AR-50, but you're still talking about a 0.5 MOA at well past 1,000 meters.
turns.zh: 射程和威力比不上AR-50，但你说的可是在超过1000米外还能保持0.5 MOA的精度。

turns.text: I've heard they're prone to jam.
